notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B workflow automation) evaluating Redwood for customer-facing chat and internal doc search. Initially trialing Hosted API to validate quality and latency; after favorable early metrics they want to move to Dedicated (VPC) for data isolation and predictable throughput. Key requirements: SOC2 or equivalent, SSO (SAML/IdP), KMS-backed key management, audit logging with >=12 months retention, and region-specific residency for EU-born customers.

POC / Technical details: Hosted POC (Feb) showed avg latency 180-220ms for 1k token queries; upstream cost sensitivity — heavy read volume during business hours (peaks ~120 qps). For Dedicated they want: pinned model version, predictable SLA, burst capacity, and routing fallback to Lower-cost model during spikes. Also asked about prefix/KV cache impact on cost and how Redwood Optimize recommendations would work on their traffic patterns.

Security review notes: Legal/infosec request list — Redwood SOC2 Type II report, SAML metadata and SP config examples, audit log schema + retention controls, KMS/HSM options, and a sample DPA with EU data residency clause. They flagged a hard requirement: VPC peering or private link (no public-facing endpoints for production model traffic).

Pricing / Commercials: Proposed commercial model — hosted = pay-as-you-go (evaluation credits used), dedicated = base monthly commit + overage. Estimated ARR range shared internally: $100k-$250k depending on reserved capacity tier. Requesting breakdown of token unit economics, expected cost per 1k QPS, and tradeoffs for quantized model variants.

Quotes / customer language: "Don't want customer PII leaving our VPC for prod — must be private and auditable." — Head of Security. "If latency under 200ms at our 95th percentile we can move forward." — Product lead.

Open items / next actions: gather SOC2 package from Redwood (requested 3/5), SAML config + test IdP metadata, detailed VPC network diagram & onboarding checklist, pricing scenario for 3 capacity tiers. Schedule: security review follow-up w/ legal & infra 2026-03-18. Decision target: end of May 2026.

Stubs/refs: see linked Drive pricing deck & security FAQ. Jira ticket INF-9812 opened for dedicated onboarding questions (SE assigned: Diego).
